### Summary

support `uv lint` command to run `ruff check`
currently  we have `uv format` to run `ruff format`
`uv check` to run `ty check`
but missing command for `ruff check`
we can use `uv lint` command to run `ruff check`
and `uv lint --fix` command to run `ruff check --fix`
